why: Fix round 2 of slice 15 of the Reflect ban (0554, ticket 1056) in next/ and our tooling, on docs/plan/quests/reflect-ban-PLAN.md law L4 and amendment point 8, on fabrikalfa/reflect-rest from 908221d20, after the recheck in field/runs/2026-11-18-reflect-ban-s13-s15-review2.json. The one finding: L4 in oxlint-plugins/advice.test.ts mapped a folder to the top that must hold a JSON.parse fire with topOf, and topOf mapped next/apps/fabrika/e2e/node to e2e, whose own files hold fires. So next/apps/fabrika/e2e/** added to the JSON.parse warn block moved e2e/node, where JSON.parse blocks today, to advice, and L4 stayed green. topOf now treats an app's e2e as it treats src: the root counts only its direct files' fires (a new directOnly helper), and each folder one level under it is its own top. A folder above the first level (next, next/packages/libfabrika, next/apps/fabrika) is direct-only too, which closes a second way the review did not name: next/packages/libfabrika/* moved the package's direct files to advice, and the old topOf excused them with the fires of the whole package. The law's comment and the stated limit now say: the only folders that advise without a fire of their own are the subfolders of a first-level folder the warn block already lists whole with **, which were at warn at the fold too.
note: Files changed: oxlint-plugins/advice.test.ts (topOf, a new directOnly, the inside helper, the law's comment) and this row. .oxlintrc.json and product code unchanged. Vitest under CI=1, nice -n 15, maxWorkers 2, TYPESAFE_API_KEY unset, on Node 22: advice.test.ts and plants.test.ts green (274 tests). pnpm format; pnpm lint (0 blocking); ratchet.ts exit 0. Every plant is a scratch edit of .oxlintrc.json (a glob inserted into the JSON.parse warn block's files, or the named edit), run once against the L4 test alone, restored by copy and checked with cmp. The old L4 (908221d20) on the same config: next/apps/fabrika/e2e/** green (the finding), next/packages/libfabrika/* green (the second way), next/apps/fabrika/** red only through src/entry. One law is green on the config as it stands; its reds are the plants.
